body:
## [3.104.0] - 2026-11-04

### Features

- add catalogue search multi-select (AION-711)
- implement detailed order loyalty receipt recovery and related logic
- add loyalty_lines_json column to synced_orders table and update related logic

### Bug Fixes

- allow clearing unpaid orders after interrupted card payments
- blend multi-select control into search background (AION-711)
- count selected quantities and minimize dialog diff (AION-711)
- align checkout overrides with loyalty receipt parameters
- ensure customer loyalty state entries are reset on customer switch and handle errors during balance refresh
- complete zero-total orders without payment selection

### Other Changes

- align transfer receipt flow with POS policy (AION-684)
- place multi-select checkbox below catalogue search (AION-711)
- Implemented in Settings → Devices → Cash On Cloud. - Checkbox defaults to unchecked, preserving the configured timeout. - Checked bypasses the payment deadline during PayTag kiosk cash-safe payments. - Cancellation and device-error handling remain active. - Setting persists across restarts; translations included.
- - Screensaver / “Continue shopping?” timeout: the previous basket remains. Reopening shows the same order. - Idle session reset (if enabled): an unpaid basket is cleared. Reopening starts an empty order. - Order with payment evidence: clearing is blocked, so the previous order remains protected. Choosing “Back to welcome” also clears an unpaid basket with the change we ma
- Fixed. PayTag now uses the regular POS loyalty calculation to print earned points, redeemed points, and balance. It also saves those details for reprints.
- add recipt button
- both sale and payment shortcut handlers now allow Regular POS (regular) and PayTag POS (paytag).
- Implemented automatic return home for the XSOS confirmation screen. - Configurable under Settings → Kiosk Screensaver → Return home after purchase. - Options: 10 seconds (default), 30 seconds, or 1 minute. - Waits while exchange-ticket printing is active.
- Fixed. The kiosk merge logic was adding a catalog item to a fuel line with the same product ID, increasing its total to 106.95.
- Implemented the PayTag kiosk discount flow: - Manager cart mode with red frame, countdown, and blocked payment. - Item/cart discounts, partial-quantity splitting, editing, and removal. - Customer-visible discounted prices and totals. - Saved 1–3 minute auto-exit setting, defaulting to 2 minutes. Focused tests passed, including RFID preservation, timeout, persistence, and localized UI. Analysis found no compile errors; existing settings warnings remain.
- Added the Named Tax Invoice / חשבונית מס שמית button beside “Your Basket.”
